tools.name: top_hiring_companies
tools.description: Which employers have the most open roles for a job title, role family and/or place, e.g. "data engineer" in "Toronto". Ranks companies by distinct open roles among the newest 3,000 matching postings; each row links to that company's matching jobs. Give at least one of title, role or location.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: salary_range · Public sink: salary_range.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: salary_range · Public sink: salary_range

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
